 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Perserverence'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Perseverance'.**
 
• The word '**perseverance**' is a **noun** that means 'persistence in doing something despite difficulty or delay in achieving success.' **(दृढ़ता)**
 
 
• **For Example -**
 
• Through hard work and perseverance, she was able to achieve her goals.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be **'Perserverence'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Malfeasance -** wrongdoing, especially by a public official **(दुराचार)**
 
• **Magnanimous -** very generous or forgiving, especially toward a rival or someone less powerful **(उदार)**
 
• **Insatiable -** impossible to satisfy **(अतृप्त)**
